text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio gives up on running in the 
Kikuka Sho. Yamanin Zephyr is crushed with 
grief, understanding the feelings of a 
fellow comrade who admired their 
respective "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she learns from her Trainer that 
there is a way of encouraging that only 
she can do. And so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr told Tokai Teio that 
declaring she would "surpass" the admired 
"Emperor" had opened her eyes. And 
therefore—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, she declared she would surpass 
the "Emperor." By conquering middle 
distances, she would achieve a "three-tier 
championship" that even the "Emperor of 
Miles" could never manage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She asked them to come watch the Sprinters 
Stakes as the first step. —There are 
feelings that an Umamusume can only convey 
through running.
